problem_statement: The CMSIS-RTOS v2 event flags implementation has a race: when a thread calls osEventFlagsSet() while another thread is blocked waiting for those flags, the waiting thread can consume the flag between the post and the state read, so osEventFlagsSet() returns a value that does not include the flag it just set. The CMSIS-RTOS specification requires osEventFlagsSet() to return the flags it set (and osEventFlagsClear()/Wait() to handle set/clear atomically). A caller that sets a flag while a waiter is blocked should observe the set flag in the return value of osEventFlagsSet().
